communication_goal: 清楚区分应该发生什么与实际发生什么，并提供证据。
image_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE standalone finished educational scene illustration, square 1024x1024. Pure white background, clean consistent black line art, minimalist adult stick figures with circular heads, simple expressive faces and thin limbs, restrained polished programmer workplace comic aesthetic. No color, no gradients, no shading, no photographic rendering. One coherent scene, no panels. Keep all people and props in the central area approximately x=180..820 and y=220..790 on a 0..1000 canvas. Preserve generous empty white space at top (y<180), bottom (y>850), and sides for learning labels added later. Make the named learning props clearly recognizable and fully visible. Gestures should show a conversation. No speech balloons, letters, numbers, captions, logos, watermarks, readable code, or long text; simple abstract UI marks are allowed. Scene: Two adult stick-figure coworkers compare evidence at a desk. A desktop monitor shows a simple abstract browser with several blank result rows. In the center foreground of the desk, place a large unobstructed paper printout of the same interface, clearly with an outer paper margin and miniature browser frame and result rows inside: this is the screenshot prop. One coworker points to the paper, the other looks at the monitor. No text, numbers, labels, or speech balloons.

coverage_review.scope: W052 的逐词编辑与底图视觉核对完成；本专题其他计划卡未制作，不声称学习效果或手机端验收。

inversion.note: 原图保留；本卡发布用图为原图精确 RGB 反色（黑底白线）。

annotation_coordinate_system: [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max]，左上角为原点，按最终 images/W052.png 宽高归一化至 0..1；由人工视觉定位。

image_review.summary: 通过：两名开发者对照显示器及桌上打印的界面截图。截图有清晰纸张外缘与界面行，完整框选其纸面；预期、实际及结果差异由对白支持，不把无文字的行列表当成确切业务数据。
